INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors builds: the rule that actually decides runs

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Every level-up deals three cards. What you take in which order decides the run, not which class you picked. The working rule is simple: minutes 0–3 take wave-clear, minutes 3–8 commit to one carry spell plus one survival tool, after minute 8 take rank-ups only.

Passive priority

  1. Blessing of Might — +10% all damage per rank, +50% at rank 5. It helps every build; take it first.
  2. Arcane Intellect — 8% faster recharge per rank, 40% at rank 5, total capped at 65%.
  3. Amplify Magic — +10% area size per rank, +50% at rank 5. Huge for Flamestrike, Consecration, Volley.
  4. Blessing of Wisdom — +8% experience per rank, +40% at rank 5. Take it early or not at all.
  5. Power Word: Fortitude — +20% max health per rank, +100% at rank 5. Buffer on squishier classes.

Stat caps

Armor caps at 60%. Once the panel shows 60% reduction, flat Armor stops helping; switch to max health, dodge, shield or regen.

Crit past 100% is not wasted — overflow converts into bonus critical damage.

Echo past 100% rolls a third strike: the first 100% guarantees a second cast on every spell, and the overflow rolls for the third.

largest health pool, Whirlwind capstone, most forgiving melee.
